title: SO-2.09 Software delivery systems: other repository hosts and issue trackers
request: Closes G-SO-20. Source: the master traceability baseline of 31 October 2026 (section 8.4) and, where named, the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0); 8.3 to 8.6 released for contracting by the owner on 31 Oct 2026. This contract is the design-record stage: it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. The programme decomposition on branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile (docs/scope-one/programme/) is read for overlap: none; GitHub stays with SO-O-B and is not repeated. Depends on contracts: SO-O-B, SO-O-C.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: The rule for every integration is the same: Memev owns the operating model and authority; the specialist system remains responsible for its own specialised capability.
The adapter layer must use canonical operation contracts. It must not let every provider create its own independent project state, permissions or acceptance model.
